name: Zenithal-Armillary
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are towering mountain ranges, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on fusion fuel are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
